## Statement

Independent loxodromics have four pairwise disjoint pole neighbourhoods in the boundary.

## Open proof obligation

**Unproved draft; authoring is incomplete.** The Hausdorff boundary topology is now complete, but the declared pole definition is not yet justified. Once four distinct well-defined poles are supplied, choose pairwise separating open sets and intersect finitely many neighbourhoods at each pole. This proves separation only; it must not be substituted for existence of independent loxodromics.
